title: schlechterella floribunda
intro: Schlechterella floribunda, commonly known as the African bushman's tea or African tea, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and other gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Schlechterella floribunda include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
